## Quality Checklist

Please verify each of the following before requesting review:

- [ ] My PR touches a single focused topic (Atomic PR).
- [ ] Commit message follows Conventional Commits (e.g., `feat(01-setup): ...`, `docs(03-clean-code): ...`).
- [ ] All code snippets, CLI commands, and config files have been tested locally.
- [ ] I followed the [Repository Rules](https://github.com/MasterZ1311/Aura/blob/main/RULES.md).
- [ ] Heading hierarchy is structured cleanly (`#` -> `##` -> `###`) and code blocks have language syntax specified.
- [ ] All relative and external hyperlinks are valid and working.
